raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

`docker/Dockerfile.stable.vllm` installs `vllm==0.24.0` and later runs `pip install transformers==${TRANSFORMERS_VERSION}` with `TRANSFORMERS_VERSION=5.3.0`. That leaves the image with a transformers version below two lower bounds:

- `vllm==0.24.0` requires `transformers>=5.5.3` (PyPI metadata);
- verl's own `requirements.txt` requires `transformers>=5.5.3,!=5.6.0,<5.17`.

The pin dates from the vllm 0.20.2 image (#6393) and was not moved when vllm was bumped (#7101). This PR raises it to `5.5.3`, the lowest version that satisfies both.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Queries: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=TRANSFORMERS_VERSION and https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=Dockerfile.stable.vllm+transformers (nothing open on this)
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

I did not build the image (CUDA devel base, flash-attn and Megatron builds). Resolver check of the two versions together with vllm, Python 3.12, x86_64 Linux:

```
$ printf 'vllm==0.24.0\ntransformers==5.5.3\n' > ok.in
$ uv pip compile ok.in --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28
# resolves: vllm==0.24.0, transformers==5.5.3, torch==2.11.0

$ printf 'vllm==0.24.0\ntransformers==5.3.0\n' > bad.in
$ uv pip compile bad.in --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28
  x No solution found when resolving dependencies:
    Because vllm==0.24.0 depends on transformers>=5.5.3 and you require
    vllm==0.24.0, we can conclude that you require transformers>=5.5.3.
```

If you prefer a different version inside the supported window (the uv workflow in `pyproject.toml` overrides it to a newer one), I am happy to change the number.

### API and Usage Example

None.

### Design & Code Changes

One `ARG` value.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the Contribute Guide.
- [ ] Apply pre-commit checks: nothing Python changed.
- [ ] Add / Update the documentation: not applicable.
- [ ] Add unit or end-to-end test(s): not feasible, this is an image build argument that CI does not exercise.
- [ ] CI request: I cannot reach the Slack workspace; a maintainer approval for the workflows is needed.
